tweetText: Omio is using OpenAI models to speed up travel product development and improve booking systems. This integration shows how tech can enhance operations instead of just being added to outdated processes. via AI News

OpenAI is collaborating with the Appia Foundation to create shared standards for advanced AI, focusing on evaluation and safety practices. This initiative is crucial for ensuring global cooperation in AI development. via OpenAI News
GPT-5 Pro helped immunologist Derya Unutmaz crack a 3-year-old mystery about T cell behavior. This breakthrough could advance research in cancer and autoimmune diseases. via OpenAI News

India's MoEngage has acquired technology to deploy AI agents tailored for each customer. This could revolutionize marketing strategies by personalizing customer interactions on a massive scale. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic launched Claude Tag, an AI that integrates into Slack to assist teams continuously. This move aims to enhance workplace productivity while capturing valuable company knowledge and workflows. via TechCrunch AI

Fika Jobs raised $4M to create a video-first hiring platform using AI agents for interviews and short video profiles. This innovation could reshape how companies connect with candidates, making hiring more engaging and efficient. via TechCrunch AI

Hollywood studios like Netflix and Warner Bros. are backing away from distributing "Artificial," a film about OpenAI's Sam Altman. This raises concerns about the industry's willingness to critique Big Tech. via The Verge AI

AI super PACs spent $27 million on a local election to influence policies affecting the tech industry. This shows how big corporations are increasingly trying to shape local governance to protect their interests. via The Verge AI

Midjourney, known for its AI image generator, is now venturing into medical imaging with a water-based ultrasound scanner. Experts are skeptical about its promises of being as effective as MRI technology. via The Verge AI

Google's Fitbit Air uses AI to provide personalized health advice, warning users about their physical state and offering tips for improvement. This smart approach could help people better manage their health and wellness. via The Verge AI
